text:
Maya: Hi all, opened a micro-PR that adds an inline SDK snippet to the auth migration page. Low-risk but want a quick sanity check + preview sign-off before merging. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024
Sam: Happy to eyeball the snippet now. Does it need a code style update to match our new lint rules?
Maya: It's small, just a 6-line example. I used the async/await pattern we prefer. No lint errors locally.
Rivka: I'll check the preview after docs-bot finishes. Netlify has been timing out for larger builds but small previews are usually ok.
docs-bot: Preview build queued: https://deploy-preview-1024--docs.redwood-inference.com (status: queued)
Sam: Quick look at the diff: can we swap the hardcoded token for an env var to discourage secrets-in-code? s/"TOKEN"/process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN/
Maya: Good catch. I'll patch that.
docs-bot: Preview build started: https://deploy-preview-1024--docs.redwood-inference.com (status: building)
Maya: Pushed change — commit a1b2c3d — replaced token with env var and added a one-line comment about scoping keys.
docs-bot: Preview build success: https://deploy-preview-1024--docs.redwood-inference.com (status: success)
Rivka: Preview looks fine. Code block renders, copy button shows, snippet imports use the approved client constructor. Tiny nit: add a link to the full SDK reference (one sentence).
Sam: LGTM with that extra link. Also recommend squash-merge to keep history tidy.
Maya: Added the reference link (commit a1b2c3e). Thanks both. I'll wait 10 minutes then merge.
release-bot: Heads up: docs merge queue currently has 2 PRs scheduled for the next deploy window. If this needs to be included in the next release notes, file a mention here.
Maya: Not required for release notes. Just a docs cleanup. Merging now.
Sam: Thanks — quick and clean.
Rivka: Nice 👏
